Which law is known as the Education Act of 1982?
  • A. Batas Pambansa Blg. 232
  • B. Republic Act 7836
  • C. Republic Act 10533
  • D. Republic Act 4670
Answer: A
BP 232 is the Education Act of 1982; RA 7836 is the professionalization act; RA 10533 is K to 12; RA 4670 is the Magna Carta for Public School Teachers.
The K to 12 law in the Philippines is
  • Republic Act 9155
  • Republic Act 10533
  • Republic Act 7722
  • Batas Pambansa Blg. 232
Republic Act 10533
